verdict.rationale: MailerSend is API-first: its own Email API, official SDKs and SMTP relay let scripts send email and manage templates and account resources without the UI, so headless automation is directly supported in principle. However, nothing in the evidence documents a CLI, CI-specific guidance, or a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404). missing for 10: official CLI, CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. a pipeline action), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
